title: SubscriberPackageVersionUninstallRequest - Tooling API
description: Represents a request to uninstall a Package2Version (second-generation package version). Available in API version 41.0 and later.

Status.description: The status of the uninstall. Valid values are: Error InProgress Queued Success

SubscriberPackageVersionId.description: The ID of the subscriber Package2 version to uninstall. The ID starts with the string 04t.
